For the fourteen days leading to qualification on SE-0061-08-05T07:29:58, Wei will make Team Fujin's existing training cycle primarily Chunin Examination preparation, emphasizing qualification readiness, field-evaluation readiness, and adaptation to unfamiliar village doctrines.

Wei will maintain Fujin on a permanent 34-hour seven-day cycle when duties permit: five 6-hour blocks, one 4-hour taper, one recovery day. Zhu and Linh alternate supervision. Priority is coordination, tactics, awareness, survival, stealth and movement before role techniques. Wei participates selectively so the team must solve problems without him. Missions, injury and exams supersede training; missed hours are not stacked.
